_comment: Reasoned, time-boxed waivers for security surfaces not yet covered by a @security scenario. Each is an explicit, reviewable decision (OWASP threat-model step 3: 'mitigate later' with a reason). Remove a surface's waiver when its @security scenario lands.

waivers.reason: Effective anti-automation on the anonymous write path requires a server-side proxy with per-IP rate limiting + Turnstile; a DB hard cap would be weaponizable to censor residents, so it is rejected. Partial mission-safe mitigations in place (append-only, synthetic-flag, coarsened timestamps). See security/anti-automation.md.
